topics.prompt: I'm going to retrieve the body of Ranger Morales.

responses.text: I wouldn't do that if I were you. Those buildings up ahead are crawling with psychos. This is as far up as we've been able to safely set up a position.
You go any further, we can't protect you, understand?
All right, smartass, I get it. You don't answer to us. But get this straight. You will get eaten alive if you go up that way.
And that's not a figure of speech, either. Bunch of sick, messed-up junkies control the road up there. Got a thing for desecrating corpses.
You've been warned.

topics.prompt: I'm going to take this basket of cakes to my grandmother's house.

responses.text: Hey, it's your life. {unconcerned - "do what you want with it."}
Least we can do. Wish we could help more.
{emphasize 2nd syllable, draw out} Bullshit. What anybody else would've done is get their asses killed. You're leading some kind of charmed life.
We'll make sure Ranger Morales' body gets sent back home. You don't have to, you know, pick him up on your shoulder and haul him to California.
Even though I believe you would if you had to. You should go tell Private Morales the news. I know she'll be relieved.

responses.text: Yeah, well, it looks like it might be too late for the Fiends. But we got the message loud and clear.
